title: Centre Notifies Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026 – An Update
content:
# Centre Notifies Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026 – An Update

Ek important update hai. Government ne **The Taxation and Other Laws (Amendment) Act, 2026** ko notify kar diya hai. This Act received the President's assent on August 17, 2026, aur Ministry of Law ne isse gazette notification ke through publish kiya hai.

Yeh Act, jo pehle ke Income-tax (Amendment) Ordinance, 2026 ko replace karta hai, kaafi significant changes laaya hai. Iska main motive foreign investment ko boost karna aur domestic manufacturing ko support karna hai.

### Key Highlights:

*   **Amendments to Existing Laws:** Is Act se Income-tax Act, 2025, Finance Act, 2026, aur Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007 mein changes kiye gaye hain.
*   **Extended Tax Exemptions for Electronics Manufacturing:** Electronic goods manufacturing ke liye tax exemptions ko ab 2040-41 tak extend kar diya gaya hai, policy certainty provide karne ke liye.
*   **Foreign Investment Funds & Fund Managers:** Eligible offshore investment funds aur fund managers ke liye tax framework ko simplify kiya gaya hai, taaki unhe India mein relocate karna easy ho.
*   **Government Securities mein Tax Exemption:** Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) aur Bank for International Settlements (BIS) ko government securities se hone waale interest income aur capital gains par tax exemption milega.
*   **Digital Payments & MDR:** Central Government ko ab yeh power di gayi hai ki woh specific electronic payment modes specify kar sakti hai jin par Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charges nahi lagenge.

Yeh amendments overall business environment ko improve karne aur India ko global capital, manufacturing, aur business ke liye ek attractive destination banane ke liye laye gaye hain.
